sentences.en: I mean, everyone knows who does live recordings.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，大家都知道是谁在做现场录音。

sentences.en: But there is also a mood, more generally, beyond the universities, that people want to consign de Gaulle to the dustbin of history.
sentences.zh: 但在大学之外，更普遍的一种情绪是，人们想要把戴高乐扫进历史的垃圾堆。

sentences.en: Well, he's old.
sentences.zh: 好吧，他老了。

sentences.en: He's old.
sentences.zh: 他老了。

sentences.en: So there's this, a guy is fined 500 francs, I learned, for shouting at de Gaulle in his car as he went by.
sentences.zh: 所以你看，我听说有个家伙因为在戴高乐的车驶过时冲车大喊而被罚款500法郎。

sentences.en: Retire.
sentences.zh: 退休吧。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So, I mean, that's quite...
sentences.zh: 所以，我的意思是，这挺……

sentences.en: He's fine for that.
sentences.zh: 他因为这个被罚款。

sentences.en: That's harsh.
sentences.zh: 这太严厉了。

sentences.en: I mean, that's quite, it is harsh, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这确实很严厉，对吧？

sentences.en: It seems quite repressive by British standards.
sentences.zh: 用英国的标准来看，这显得相当压制。

sentences.en: That's one thing that people also, I mean, they don't get about France today, even.
sentences.zh: 这也是人们，我的意思是，即使在今天也依然无法理解法国的一点。

sentences.en: France is a much more hierarchical society, much more paternalistic than often people sitting in Britain, who have the fantasy of France, believe.
sentences.zh: 法国是一个阶层分化得多、也更家长式的社会，这往往超出了那些坐在英国、对法国抱有幻想的人的想象。

sentences.en: So, it's still a very Catholic country.
sentences.zh: 所以，它依然是一个非常天主教的国家。

sentences.en: It's sort of officially, at least, not a diverse country.
sentences.zh: 至少从表面上看，它不是一个多元文化的国家。

sentences.en: I mean, there are a lot of new immigrants and things, but they don't feature...
sentences.zh: 我是说，这里有很多新移民之类的，但他们并不显眼……

sentences.en: They've all been parked on the periphery.
sentences.zh: 他们全都被边缘化了。

sentences.en: They've all been locked up in their tower blocks.
sentences.zh: 他们全都被锁在各自的高层住宅里。

sentences.en: There is a real sense of deference to authority far greater, I would say, than in Britain or America.
sentences.zh: 我认为，这里对权威的顺从感远远超过了英国或美国。

sentences.en: And so, therefore, presumably, rebelling against it becomes more fun.
sentences.zh: 因此，反抗权威大概也就变得更有趣了。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: So, actually, even though, at the beginning of 1968, all the sort of talk is, well, there's stuff going on in America and so on, but it will never spread to France.
sentences.zh: 所以，实际上，尽管在1968年初，所有的言论都在说，美国那边确实发生了很多事之类的事情，但它绝不会蔓延到法国。

sentences.en: Because, you know, we're not like that, and our kids aren't like that.
sentences.zh: 因为，你知道，我们不是那样的人，我们的孩子也不是那样。

sentences.en: I think, particularly in these places where nobody really looks.
sentences.zh: 我认为，尤其是在那些根本没有人关注的地方。

sentences.en: So, out in the suburbs, in these kind of jerry-built, sort of breeze-block, unfinished building site universities, there is a sense of discontent that is mounting.
sentences.zh: 因此，在郊区，在这些豆腐渣工程般的、由煤渣砖砌成的、尚未完工的建筑工地大学里，不满情绪正在不断滋长。

sentences.en: And, Tom, all it takes is the trigger.
sentences.zh: 而且，汤姆，这一切只需要一个导火索。

sentences.en: And as we see the bin lorry go around the corner, I think we should seize this moment to go to a cafe.
sentences.zh: 当我们看到垃圾车拐过街角时，我想我们应该抓住这个时刻去一家咖啡馆。

sentences.en: Let's walk through the Latin Quarter.
sentences.zh: 让我们穿过拉丁区吧。

sentences.en: And so, perhaps, in a cafe, we could have, just before we get on to the explosion, perhaps, could we have just a brief chat about French philosophy and absurdist theatre?
sentences.zh: 或许，在去探讨大爆发之前，我们可以在咖啡馆里简单聊聊法国哲学和荒诞派戏剧？

sentences.en: That sounds awful.
sentences.zh: 听起来糟糕透了。

sentences.en: We'll be sitting in a cafe as Marive goes.
sentences.zh: 我们坐在咖啡馆里，而玛丽沃正在播放。

sentences.en: I knew you would try to bring that up.
sentences.zh: 我就知道你会想提起这个。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: So, let's go and do that.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们去吧。

sentences.en: Well, let's go to the cafe.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们去咖啡馆吧。

sentences.en: So, Tom, hello.
sentences.zh: 汤姆，你好。

sentences.en: Here we are in the cafe.
sentences.zh: 我们现在在咖啡馆里了。

sentences.en: There's been a slight dispute about whether to sit inside or out.
sentences.zh: 对于是坐在里面还是外面，我们产生了一点小小的争论。

sentences.en: We're sitting outside.
sentences.zh: 我们坐在外面。

sentences.en: We're sitting outside, which is as I wanted.
sentences.zh: 我们坐在外面，这正是我的愿望。

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 确实是。

sentences.en: I wanted to sit inside, because I always imagine philosophers in Paris sitting inside the cafe.
sentences.zh: 我本来想坐里面，因为我脑海中的巴黎哲学家总是坐在咖啡馆里面。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: But, as ever, you've bullied me.
sentences.zh: 但如往常一样，你把我给说服了。

sentences.en: No, that's absolutely wrong.
sentences.zh: 不，完全不是这样。

sentences.en: True.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: I think there's a general sense that it's actually a lovely day.
sentences.zh: 我觉得大家的普遍感受是今天天气其实非常好。

sentences.en: It is gorgeous, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 天气太棒了，不是吗？

sentences.en: It's a beautiful Parisian day.
sentences.zh: 这是一个美好的巴黎日子。

sentences.en: Because you don't like Paris, or are you being converted now to the beauties of…
sentences.zh: 是因为你不喜欢巴黎，还是你现在已经被……的美丽所折服了？

sentences.en: I'm officially repenting.
sentences.zh: 我正式宣布洗心革面了。

sentences.en: Are you?
sentences.zh: 是吗？

sentences.en: Actually, this is lovely.
sentences.zh: 其实，这感觉真好。

sentences.en: I'm really enjoying this.
sentences.zh: 我真的很享受。

sentences.en: Paris is working her magic on you.
sentences.zh: 巴黎正对你施展它的魔力呢。

sentences.en: I've never been in such nice weather.
sentences.zh: 我从来没遇到过这么好的天气。

sentences.en: The city looks gorgeous.
sentences.zh: 这座城市看起来美极了。

sentences.en: It looks golden.
sentences.zh: 它看起来金灿灿的。

sentences.en: The river's sane, glistening in the sunlight.
sentences.zh: 河水清澈，在阳光下波光粼粼。

sentences.en: So, Dominic, you may actually come back after this.
sentences.zh: 所以，多米尼克，这次之后你可能还会再来。

sentences.en: And if you do…
sentences.zh: 如果你来的话……

sentences.en: I would use my WiseCard.
sentences.zh: 我会用我的WiseCard。

sentences.en: You would use your WiseCard, as we're going to do now, because we're going to order a coffee, aren't we?
sentences.zh: 你会用你的WiseCard，就像我们现在要做的那样，因为我们要点咖啡了，对吧？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: We're going to use our WiseCards for coffee.
sentences.zh: 我们要用WiseCard买咖啡。

sentences.en: I will just say this, that whether you are taking on Rio or Rome, Miami or Mumbai, or in our case, Tom, Paris or Amsterdam, now here's the good news.
sentences.zh: 我只想说，无论你是去里约还是罗马，迈阿密还是孟买，或者像我们一样，汤姆，去巴黎或阿姆斯特丹，好消息来了。

sentences.en: You will always get the mid-market exchange rate when you convert currencies.
sentences.zh: 在兑换货币时，你总是能获得中间市场汇率。

sentences.en: And, Tom, I know you're passionate about avoiding markups.
sentences.zh: 而且，汤姆，我知道你最痛恨支付溢价。

sentences.en: I don't…
sentences.zh: 我才不……

sentences.en: I hate markups.
sentences.zh: 我讨厌溢价。

sentences.en: You don't…
sentences.zh: 你才不……

sentences.en: You really don't like…
sentences.zh: 你真的很讨厌……

sentences.en: And I hate hidden fees.
sentences.zh: 我讨厌隐性费用。

sentences.en: Hidden fees.
sentences.zh: 隐性费用。

sentences.en: And there are neither of those things.
sentences.zh: 这两样东西都没有。

sentences.en: So, as usual, a large lorry has just turned up.
sentences.zh: 所以，像往常一样，一辆大卡车刚刚开过来。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Which always happens.
sentences.zh: 这种事总是发生。

sentences.en: And I knew this would happen, which is why I wanted to go inside.
sentences.zh: 我早就知道会这样，这也是我刚才想坐里面的原因。

sentences.en: But I'm not going to…
sentences.zh: 不过我不会……

sentences.en: I'm not going to say I told you.
sentences.zh: 我不会说“我早就告诉过你”。

sentences.en: Tom, I will mollify you now with a lovely French coffee.
sentences.zh: 汤姆，我现在用一杯美味的法式咖啡来抚慰你受伤的心灵。

sentences.en: What would you like?
sentences.zh: 你想喝点什么？

sentences.en: I would like a…
sentences.zh: 我想来一杯……

sentences.en: Here's the waitress.
sentences.zh: 女服务员来了。

sentences.en: Bonjour.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: Un café au lait pour…
sentences.zh: 一杯咖啡牛奶给……

sentences.en: Pour le monsieur.
sentences.zh: 给这位先生。

sentences.en: Ce vieux gentilhomme est un café au lait pour moi.
sentences.zh: 这位老绅士要一杯咖啡牛奶。

sentences.en: Merci.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好了。

sentences.en: Let's talk philosophy.
sentences.zh: 我们来谈谈哲学吧。

sentences.en: Go ahead.
sentences.zh: 请讲。

sentences.en: So, part of the kind of the vibe in Paris in the 60s.
sentences.zh: 那么，60年代巴黎的某种氛围之一就是……

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: They're very into their situationist, absurdist theater.
sentences.zh: 他们非常热衷于情境主义和荒诞派戏剧。

sentences.en: The transfiguration of the absurdity of bourgeois life.
sentences.zh: 将资产阶级生活的荒诞性进行升华。

sentences.en: I knew you were going to bring all this stuff up.
sentences.zh: 我就知道你会把这些东西都搬出来。

sentences.en: So, I know the answer to this.
sentences.zh: 所以，我知道这个问题的答案。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Do you think that this has any influence on the course of 68?
sentences.zh: 你认为这会对68年的进程产生任何影响吗？

sentences.en: No, see, I don't, actually.
sentences.zh: 不，实际上我觉得没有。

sentences.en: I think it's absolutely true that people are staging happenings and they are…
sentences.zh: 我认为人们确实在策划偶发艺术，而且他们……

sentences.en: I mean, existentialism is old, by the way, at this point.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，到这个时候，存在主义已经不新鲜了。

sentences.en: People often think existentialism and Sartre, Camus, all that stuff is one of the drivers of this.
sentences.zh: 人们常常认为存在主义、萨特、加缪以及所有这些东西是这次运动的推动力之一。

sentences.en: But I'm talking about Antonin Artaud, absurdité, all that kind of thing.
sentences.zh: 但我指的是安托万·阿尔托、荒诞学说（l'absurdité）以及所有这类东西。

sentences.en: And also, the rising French philosopher, Michel Foucault.
sentences.zh: 还有当时正在崛起的法国哲学家米歇尔·福柯。

sentences.en: Michel Foucault.
sentences.zh: 米歇尔·福柯。

sentences.en: So, he's published Les Moets, Les Chaux, which I think is…
sentences.zh: 所以，他出版了《词与物》，我认为这……

sentences.en: I can't remember what it's called.
sentences.zh: 我不记得它叫什么了。

sentences.en: Words and things.
sentences.zh: 《词与物》（Words and things）。

sentences.en: Yeah, but it's not translated as that.
sentences.zh: 对，但它的翻译不是那个名字。

sentences.en: I think, I can't remember.
sentences.zh: 我想，我记不清了。

sentences.en: Order of things, is it?
sentences.zh: 是《事物的秩序》对吧？

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: I'm not as familiar with Foucault as well as yours, Tom.
sentences.zh: 我对福柯的了解不如你深，汤姆。

sentences.en: But anyway, so in that, in Les Moets et Les Chaux, he is essentially arguing that everything is oppression.
sentences.zh: 但无论如何，在《词与物》中，他基本上是在论证一切都是压迫。

sentences.en: Yes, of course.
sentences.zh: 是的，当然。

sentences.en: That culture, knowledge, patriotism are merely discourses of power.
sentences.zh: 文化、知识、爱国主义不过是权力的说辞。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: I mean, again, I know that you, because I know your material is bent, that you will poo-poo this.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，再次声明，我知道由于你的立场偏颇，你会对这种观点嗤之以鼻。

sentences.en: But does this idea that, so the catchwords for goalism, patrie, all that kind of thing, well, la France, that these are simply discourses of oppression.
sentences.zh: 但是，这种观点——也就是戴高乐主义的流行语，如“祖国”（patrie）及诸如此类的词汇，好吧，还有“法兰西”，它们不过是压迫的说辞——

sentences.en: Does that kind of steal the student leaders?
sentences.zh: 这难道会赋予学生领袖某种力量吗？

sentences.en: Does it provide them with a kind of ideological backbone?
sentences.zh: 这是否为他们提供了一种思想脊梁？

sentences.en: I don't really think it does.
sentences.zh: 我真的觉得没有。

sentences.en: I actually think that stuff becomes important after 68.
sentences.zh: 我实际上认为这些东西在68年之后才变得重要。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And it does create the memory.
sentences.zh: 而且它确实创造了某种记忆。

sentences.en: I mean, it does become associated with the memory of 68, particularly in the 70s.
sentences.zh: 我是说，它确实与68年的记忆联系在了一起，尤其是在70年代。

sentences.en: Because Foucault himself is in Tunis at the time, isn't he?
sentences.zh: 因为福柯本人当时在突尼斯，对吧？

sentences.en: He is, exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错，确实如此。

sentences.en: He's in North Africa.
sentences.zh: 他在北非。

sentences.en: And he is, I mean, he's the philosopher who's most identified, I suppose, with the
sentences.zh: 而且他，我的意思是，他可以说是最能代表……的哲学家

sentences.en: Evenement of 1968 and the spirit of 68.
sentences.zh: 1968年的“事件”（Evenement）和68年精神的哲学家。

sentences.en: But he's in North Africa.
sentences.zh: 但他却身在北非。

sentences.en: And as the events unfold, he's actually writing to friends saying, what's going on?
sentences.zh: 随着事件的展开，他其实一直在写信给朋友问，到底发生什么事了？

sentences.en: I've got no idea what's going on.
sentences.zh: 我完全不知道外面在发生什么。

sentences.en: I don't understand it.
sentences.zh: 我搞不懂。

sentences.en: I mean, you know, the influence of a philosopher isn't to be measured by whether the philosopher himself is in person.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你知道，一个哲学家的影响力不能以他本人是否亲临现场来衡量。

sentences.en: But this is not like Rousseau in the French Revolution.
sentences.zh: 但这不像法国大革命时期的卢梭。

sentences.en: During the Evenement of May 1968, people aren't generally quoting Foucault.
sentences.zh: 在1968年5月的“事件”期间，人们通常并不怎么引用福柯的话。

sentences.en: Foucault's name does not appear in a lot of the coverage.
sentences.zh: 在许多报道中并没有出现福柯的名字。

sentences.en: Nobody is pointing the finger at...
sentences.zh: 没有人把矛头指向...

sentences.en: I think this is something that actually, I mean, some listeners to this may say, oh, no, no, this is far too reductioniSt.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这其实是那种，我的意思是，有些听众听到这可能会说，哦，不，不，这未免也太过于简单化了。

sentences.en: But actually, I think a lot of this is actually generated afterwards.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，我认为这里面很大一部分都是事后脑补出来的。

sentences.en: But by the people in Poland, in cafes, trying to explain what has happened.
sentences.zh: 是由那些身在波兰的咖啡馆里、试图解释发生了什么的人编造的。

sentences.en: See, I actually think when you get down to the...
sentences.zh: 你看，我其实觉得当你深入到...

sentences.en: We talked about the trigger.
sentences.zh: 我们刚才聊到了导火索。

sentences.en: And you were talking about this.
sentences.zh: 而你刚才就在说这个。

sentences.en: Well, we were both talking about the grimness of the suburbs.
sentences.zh: 对，我们俩当时都在谈论郊区的沉闷阴暗。

sentences.en: And of the new university buildings and so on.
sentences.zh: 还有那些新盖的大学教学楼等等。

sentences.en: The trigger is in many ways very, very mundane.
sentences.zh: 在很多方面，导火索其实非常非常世俗、极其普通。

sentences.en: So the place, it's seven miles northwest of Paris.
sentences.zh: 所以这个地方，它位于巴黎西北七英里处。

sentences.en: And it's a suburb called Nanterre.
sentences.zh: 那是一个叫做楠泰尔的郊区。

sentences.en: And in Nanterre, they have started to build in 1962, basically one of these annexes, one of these overspill buildings, overspill campuses for the Sorbonne, where we were earlier.
sentences.zh: 在楠泰尔，他们在1962年开始建造基本上是这种附属建筑、疏散建筑之一，也就是我们之前提到的索邦大学的疏散校区之一。

sentences.en: And there are about 12,000 students at Nanterre.
sentences.zh: 楠泰尔大约有12,000名学生。

sentences.en: And Nanterre is the middle of nowhere.
sentences.zh: 而且楠泰尔简直就是鸟不拉屎的荒郊野岭。

sentences.en: It is basically a massive building site.
sentences.zh: 它基本上就是一个巨大的工地。

sentences.en: The buildings haven't been finished.
sentences.zh: 建筑物根本还没建好。

sentences.en: The students have kind of been lied to.
sentences.zh: 学生们可以说是被忽悠了。

sentences.en: They've been told they're all these tremendous facilities.
sentences.zh: 他们被告知这里有各种各样无与伦比的设施。

sentences.en: But actually, as the Guardian, the British newspaper, put it at the time, on 7th of May 1968, it
sentences.zh: 但实际上，正如英国报纸《卫报》在当年1968年5月7日所报道的那样，它

sentences.en: said Nanterre was ironically meant as a model for the future, but it's turned out to have the academic atmosphere of a railway station.
sentences.zh: 说楠泰尔原本讽刺般地被设计成未来的模范校园，结果却沦落得有着火车站一般的学术氛围。

sentences.en: Not even that.
sentences.zh: 甚至还不如火车站。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Because railway stations at least have kind of cafes.
sentences.zh: 因为火车站好歹还有个咖啡馆啥的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对吧。

sentences.en: So in Nanterre, there is nothing.
sentences.zh: 所以楠泰尔那里什么都没有。

sentences.en: And it feels you're a long way from, you're seven miles out of the city.
sentences.zh: 而且你会觉得自己离市区好远，你距离城里有七英里远。

sentences.en: You can't get into the city.
sentences.zh: 你根本进不去城。

sentences.en: The transport links are rubbish.
sentences.zh: 交通连接烂透了。

sentences.en: There are no facilities.
sentences.zh: 没有任何设施。

sentences.en: It is grim, unfinished kind of tower blocks.
